title: Power-torsion complexes have no shifted maps to localized modules
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, and use its module-sheaf category on the one-object bottom site [def-pc-ring-hom-extension-shared-definitions] with a chosen derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $T$ be any cochain complex and $s\in A$. Suppose for each $i\in\mathbb Z$ and each element $x$ of the point value of $H^i(T)$ there is $k\in\mathbb N$ with $s^k x=0$. Let $M$ be a module sheaf such that multiplication by $s$ on its point value is bijective. Then every morphism $Q(T)[n]\to Q(M[0])$ is zero, for every $n\in\mathbb Z$. No Cech model, ideal, or boundedness assumption occurs.

proof.text: Evaluate sheaves at the unique point and construct the inverse constant-module functor, giving an additive equivalence with ordinary A-modules. Compose evaluation with extension of scalars to B=A[1/s]. Flatness gives exactness. The homology of this functor applied to T is zero: IsLocalizedModule.subsingleton_iff turns the power annihilator of each class into a zero localized module. The standard homology and derived-functor comparison isomorphisms therefore identify its derived image with a zero object, including after any shift.

proof.text: The identity map on the point-value of M is a module localization: multiplication by every s-power is invertible by the assumed bijectivity, and surjectivity and equality after localization hold already with denominator one. Use the actual IsLocalizedModule.module construction to give M its B-action. The identity linear maps identify restriction of this B-module with the original A-module, and the point equivalence identifies the resulting sheaf.

proof.text: Compose extension/restriction of scalars with the point equivalence. Apply the existing exact-derived-adjunction construction to this adjunction. Identify the restricted single complex by the single/mapHomologicalComplex and standard derived-functor factorization isomorphisms. The adjunction Hom equivalence is surjective and identifies the specified morphism with a map from the zero localized shifted source. That map is zero; the adjunction preserves zero and cancellation of the target isomorphism finishes.

theorem power_torsion_localized_shift_hom
    (A : CommRingCat.{u}) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (RingSiteModules A)]
    (T : CochainComplex (RingSiteModules A) ℤ) (s : A)
    (hT : ∀ (i : ℤ) (x : (T.homology i).val.obj (op ⟨PUnit.unit⟩)),
      ∃ k : ℕ, s ^ k • x = 0)
    (M : RingSiteModules A)
    (hM : Function.Bijective
      (fun x : M.val.obj (op ⟨PUnit.unit⟩) ↦ s • x))
    (n : ℤ)
    (f : (DerivedCategory.Q.obj T)⟦n⟧ ⟶
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        ((HomologicalComplex.single (RingSiteModules A) (.up ℤ) 0).obj M)) :
    f = 0
